text: A kneeling woman with dark skin, appearing young adult, has a slender build. Her long black hair flows down her back; face is oval with pale lips. She wears a light brown bikini top and bottom. A tall figure in a purple robe stands behind her, hand near the kneeling woman’s head. Another figure with white hair sits facing them, gesturing with open hands. The scene is dimly lit, underwater or cavernous, with blue-green hues dominating.
